name: Undefined event
description: Warns about event handlers whose names are not defined anywhere in the script's ancestry.
definition: Flags an `Event` handler whose name is not declared as an event by the script it `Extends` or any of that script's ancestors. Papyrus accepts an arbitrary event name, but a misspelled or otherwise undefined handler is never invoked. The lint only reports a child script after its complete ancestry has been resolved; root scripts and unresolved external scripts are skipped rather than guessed at.
